gap: Logs never reviewed
remediation: Monthly review (POAM-006)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Not applicable: no internal workforce to communicate with. Any future hire or subcontractor is briefed and trained before access (POL-01 5.2)
Customer contacts and notice clocks set in the P08 runbook and matrix; not yet confirmed or printed. The account list and POA&M summary go to the city IT manager by 2026-09-30
gap: Contacts not confirmed; city not yet given the account list
remediation: Confirm and print contacts; send the account list (POAM-007)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives come from the two contracts, POL-01, and the BIA (P05)
First risk assessment completed 2026-08-14 (P01, 15 risks)
Fraud scenarios (fake change requests to door schedules or badges, invoice redirection) are not yet in the register
gap: Fraud not assessed
remediation: Add social engineering of badge and schedule requests at the next review; confirm every badge or door change request by phone with the city facilities manager

gap: No independent evaluation; checks not yet running
remediation: Start monthly checks; outside review by 2027-08-31

control_description: Owner's direct oversight: deficiencies go straight into the POA&M (P07), and those affecting the city go to the city IT manager

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline required by the city and tailored in P03
Technology controls rely on SaaS providers, device vendors, and the city; owner-side settings (accounts, MFA, encryption) are partly in place
gap: Router and remote-desktop settings never reviewed
remediation: Baseline checklist and quarterly settings check

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 adopted 2026-09-04; most procedures are written into the policy itself

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on the suite, VPN, and tenant; laptop encrypted. Remote-desktop agent bypassed the city VPN; the BAS supervisory controller uses one shared administrator account with a 2023 password
gap: Unauthorized remote path and shared administrator password
remediation: Remove the agent (POAM-001); named BAS account and password change (POAM-002)

control_description: City IT issues the owner's VPN and tenant accounts; the owner registers SaaS accounts. No account list existed before P04
gap: City has no list of the owner's accounts
remediation: Quarterly account list to the city IT manager (POL-01 7.8)

control_description: Daily laptop work under an administrator account; the owner has full administrator rights in the city tenant for cardholder work
gap: No least privilege on the laptop
remediation: Standard account (POAM-003); ask the city whether a narrower tenant role fits the owner's work

control_description: Locked home office and van cabinet; laptop not left in the van overnight
Paper shredded; removed customer equipment returned to the customer; no device wipe procedure for the owner's own devices
gap: No device disposal procedure
remediation: POL-01 8.7 wipe or certified destruction with a record

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Laptop firewall on; city systems reached only through the city VPN once the agent is removed; home router on default settings with a flat network
gap: Unmanaged home network
remediation: Owner-owned router with a separate work network (R-012)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: CUI and exempt city records shared by email and from the general folder; one "anyone with the link" link found and closed 2026-08-12; city data pasted into a consumer chatbot
gap: Data movement not restricted
remediation: Restricted CUI folder and sharing rules (POAM-005); no customer data in unapproved services (POL-01 9.4)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Built-in antivirus with real-time protection and automatic updates; software installed freely under the administrator account
gap: No install control
remediation: Standard account blocks most installs (POAM-003)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Operating system updates automatic; router firmware and BAS engineering software not checked for known vulnerabilities; controller programs not compared with saved copies before P07
gap: No vulnerability or integrity checks
remediation: Quarterly version check and program comparison

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: New sign-in alerts on in the suite and tenant; no review of the remote session log or audit trail
gap: No monitoring of the riskiest path
remediation: Monthly review; weekly until the agent is removed (POAM-006)

control_description: Incident log started 2026-08-12; two events evaluated and reported (CUI link, chatbot paste)
P08 runbook adopted 2026-09-04; not yet walked through; no outside responder or cyber insurance
gap: Untested; no outside help lined up
remediation: Walkthrough and tabletop (POAM-007); cyber insurance quotes

control_description: SaaS data recoverable from the providers; controller programs have a single stale copy on the laptop
gap: Controller programs not recoverable to the RPO
remediation: Backups and quarterly comparison (POAM-004)

control_description: Changes to city systems are approved by the city facilities manager in writing before the owner makes them (city contract). The owner's own device and tenant changes are not recorded
gap: No record of the owner's own changes
remediation: Change log in the security folder (CM-3)

control_description: Single-person dependency: no backup technician, no manual operation sheets, no sealed emergency access, no cyber insurance
gap: The owner is a single point of failure
remediation: Backup controls firm approved by the city; manual sheets; sealed envelope (R-006)
